children: plans to hold its 2026 Prime Big Deal Days sale on October 6–7, beginning at 12:01 a.m. Pacific time. The 48-hour event is limited to Prime members and will feature “millions” of discounts across electronics, home goods, fashion, beauty, toys, groceries, and Amazon devices. The Seattle-based e-commerce giant noted well over one million items will be at their lowest price of the year to date.
As part of the Prime Big Deal Days sales event, Amazon
will fire off discounts of 45% or more on selected Sony
products, as well as up to 45% off fall apparel and shoes and up to 35% off bedding, blankets, and holiday décor. Some Halloween costumes and accessories will be listed starting at $5.

is also using the event to promote its broader membership ecosystem. Pre-event offers include Prime Card rewards; discounts tied to American Express and Mercury points; a $20 Grubhub promotion; reduced-price digital subscriptions; and a $1,500 Amazon gift card for qualifying new-vehicle purchases or leases through Amazon Autos.
has run the same basic fall, Prime-member-only sales event every year since 2022 under different names.
trickled 0.4% lower in premarket action on Tuesday after slipping 1.3% on Monday.

title: Amazon sets dates for its Prime Big Deal Days shopping event
